steps.action: Block the attacking IP at the perimeter — it is actively probing multiple services simultaneously.
List every service attacked (SSH, HTTP, FTP, SMB, etc.) and check if any returned success responses.
For every service that returned a success: treat associated accounts as compromised and lock them.
Correlate with threat intel — coordinated multi-service attacks often come from botnet infrastructure.
Enforce MFA across all internet-facing services. Reduce exposed attack surface — disable protocols not in active use.
Implement unified rate-limiting and cross-service anomaly detection (e.g. same IP failing on SSH then HTTP within seconds).
Document all targeted services, time window, and outcome per service. Add IP to long-term blocklist.
